results.content: Home » B-Sides raises $500,000 in seed round. # B-Sides raises $500,000 in seed round. — B-Sides has raised a $500,000 seed funding round led by Cap Ventures 8182. Founded by Yousuf Ahmed in 2025, B-Sides produces snack puffs that are formulated with upcycled ingredients including oat flour from oat milk production and corn grits from milling. The funding will be used to expand its retail footprint, invest in sales and marketing and begin vertically integrating its upcycled ingredient supply chain. Consumers may purchase B-Sides online via Amazon, TikTok Shop and the company’s website. results.title: MOSH raises $13 million - Food Business News
results.content: Home » MOSH raises $13 million. # MOSH raises $13 million. LOS ANGELES — MOSH, which stands for Maria Owings Shriver Health, has raised $13 million in a Series A funding round led by Main Street Advisors. The cognitive health startup, co-founded by Maria Shriver and Patrick Schwarzenegger, manufactures bars and will use the funds for national retail expansion. The company’s newest innovation is MOSH High Protein, a bar that is formulated with 20 grams of protein, creatine and ingredients to promote cognitive health. In addition to the MOSH High Protein bar, the company also launched a vegan protein bar collection in hazelnut chocolate chip, peanut chocolate chip and chocolate chip cookie verities last year. In 2024, the company updated its packaging and formulation and raised $3 million in a Series A funding round in 2023. ## MOSH raises $3 million in Series A funding. ## Better-for-you energy drink raises $13 million. ## Imagindairy raises $13 million. ## Bachan’s raises $13 million.

results.content: Home » French fry startup raises $10 million Series A. # French fry startup raises $10 million Series A. WASHINGTON — Jesse & Ben’s has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round led by Greycroft. The funding round will help the seed-oil-free french fry startup with continued retail expansion, supply chain investment and building its leadership team. Jesse & Ben’s was founded by restaurant operators Jesse Konig and Ben Johnson and landed on shelves in June 2024. “When we started Jesse & Ben’s, the goal was simple: turn junk food into joy food,” Konig said. “Jesse and Ben’s is doing exactly what we look for in the future of food: taking a massive, legacy category like frozen fries and completely reinventing it with a clean label, brand-led approach,” said Brian Bernstein, principal at Rich Products Ventures. ## Cultivated meat startup raises $22 million in Series A round. ## Sanzo raises $10 million in Series A funding.
